offering_description.value: Olin manufactures and distributes chlor-alkali products, vinyl products, and epoxy materials for industrial customers. It also manufactures small-caliber ammunition in the United States.

quotes.quote: Olin Corporation is a global manufacturer and distributor of chemical products and a leading U.S. manufacturer of ammunition. Our worldwide commitment to continuous innovation, superior safety and exceptional service ensures customer success throughout the chemical value chain and beyond.

Olin Corporation began as a small blasting powder supplier in East Alton, Illinois. Following a few decades of success, along with some fruitful acquisitions, Olin has grown and expanded to encompass three business units —Olin Chlor Alkali Products & Vinyls, Olin Epoxy, and Winchester Ammunition.
